about: A cave-exploration game in the style of Zork and Colossal Cave. A wizard's spell, "Fantasize!", seems to make the rooms briefly produce things that aren't real, such as a pile of jewels.

done.why: After a few minutes I had no goal and was only walking through cave rooms. The Carousel Room's disorienting exits and the rockfall dead end felt like a maze, and nothing pulled me on.

moments.note: A Wizard appears, waves his wand and says 'Fantasize!'. It is the first hint that something odd is going on.
I couldn't take the jewels. The room says it has the grace to look embarrassed. That was a clever, funny reply.
The Carousel Room's disorienting exits, plus a rockfall dead end, felt like a maze with no purpose.

wished: A clear goal or hook within the first few moves.
To find out what the Wizard's spell was doing to the rooms.

lines.line: Your hand closes on nothing, and your eye on less. It was never there: the Wizard's word put it in the room, and the room, having no say in the matter, let it, and has the grace to look embarrassed about it now.
lines.why: The best line I read. It has real voice and ties the Wizard's spell to the room.

fun.why: There was one good moment, then plain wandering.

engagement.why: I had no goal and quit quickly.

difficulty.why: Nothing blocked me hard, but there was no direction either.

interestingness.why: The Wizard and the room that lets itself be fooled are intriguing. The rest is familiar Zork-style cave.

prose.why: The room descriptions are standard. The jewels reply stands out as better.
